title: Draw the Place · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Draw the Place · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Agree on a list of familiar places such as a beach or library. The lead draws three objects commonly found in one selected place. The others identify the place from the three clues. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: Paper and pencil; a timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Draw the Place, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The others identify the place from the three clues.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The others identify the place from the three clues.
